storage: Keep unwashed in a paper-lined box or bag in the fridge and use within 2 to 3 days. Blanched, squeezed purée can be frozen for later use.
looksLike: Bunches of flat, smooth, dark-green, spoon-shaped leaves on thin green stems, sold with or without the pinkish roots.
howToPick: Fresh, uniformly dark-green, crisp leaves with thin stems. Avoid yellow, slimy or wilted leaves, and bunches with a sour smell.
shelfLife: Fresh leaves keep about 2 to 3 days in the fridge (general guidance, not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 150 g leaves per serving (about 220 g as bought with stems); the lighter variant uses 200 g
